meta.description: Split-screen first layout: all major sections use 50/50 or weighted vertical division. The split line IS the design element.

container.note: Full-bleed split panels — edge to edge, no container gutters. Inner content uses panel_padding.

mobile.behavior: Stacks vertically — accent panel becomes horizontal band above content

tablet.behavior: Split panels maintain but compress to equal 50/50

wide.behavior: Max width cap, panels never exceed combined 1440px

css_implementation: CSS Grid with grid-template-columns — two-column, variable ratios via custom properties
